units.source_text: ……所谓事件，在某一地点将会从我们的记忆中消失。

en.t: ...What we call an event will, at a certain point, disappear from our memory.

units.source_text: 攀登一百零五级缀满苔藓的石阶的有为子，还在眼前。

en.t: Uiko, climbing the one hundred and five moss-covered stone steps, is still before my eyes.

units.source_text: 我觉得她仿佛永远在攀登这石阶似的。

en.t: It seems to me as though she is climbing those stone steps forever.
